text_block_list.text:
Now, they enter the curve of the third 
corner! Will any Umamusume break away from 
here?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...I can hear the breathing of the 
runners. The heat of the competition 
transmits right through my skin.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The one who will seize victory—is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-What was that running style of hers...! 
In that single moment, she looked more 
like a monster than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now that's interesting! I will surpass 
you, no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. But it's still not enough. I can 
still become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So, what should I enter next? Out 
with it quickly. Before this flame dies 
down.

What came to mind was the pinnacle stage 
that one can only challenge once in a 
lifetime.

It was a title that lay beyond the 
pinnacle of fierce Triple Crown 
competition.
choice_data_list:
Why don't we aim for the Classic Triple 
Crown?
Wanna aim for the Classic Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: First up is the Satsuki Sho, then.

And so, Narita Brian and I set our sights 
on the Satsuki Sho.
